'Small units leave fewer places to hide' (line 61) vs 'fewer escape routes' (line 63) — escape routes = places to hide, matches. Remaining five headers (Acceptance tests / TDD / Mutation testing / Human's job / A prompt biases the agent) restate their chunk's bolded-lead sentence directly.
